lessons_used: Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) and adding a pet controls quickstart screen (finish, new_screen) were helpful and won, though evidence remains thin with only 1 test each.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change categories, as each has only a single test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all non-winning tests.
Both winning tests (sign_in, reorder and finish, new_screen) were significantly underpredicted.

candidates.title: Add Pet Interaction Sound Check Screen
candidates.change: Adds a final audio and voice test screen right before completion so users can verify pet audio and interaction controls.
candidates.why: Support emails show confusion around pet controls (3 emails) and desktop audio/feature behavior (4 emails). Testing audio responsiveness upfront confirms setup.

new_sound_check.headline: Test Pet Voice & Desktop Sounds
new_sound_check.body: Click below to test your pet's audio responses before jumping to your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a new sound check screen after home intro within onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage has moderate drop-off and strong email evidence; new_screen on finish previously won with +3.4% lift.

candidates.title: Redesign Photo Upload with Split Layout and Sample Gallery
candidates.change: Redesigns photo upload into a split layout presenting live photo upload alongside sample visual references.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the highest drop-off (60.9% conversion, median 89s) and 3 emails reported custom pet creation failures.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload layout while keeping the photo upload functionality is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step with email support, but redesigns have consistently reduced conversion across previous tests.

candidates.title: Add Pet Naming and Voice Audio Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a pet naming and voice audition screen between pick friend and photo upload.
candidates.why: Adoption has the biggest friction (60.9% conversion). Giving users immediate ownership over pet name and sound preview builds investment before asset generation.

new_pet_naming.headline: Name Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_naming.body: Choose a custom name and audition voice sounds for your companion.

guard.reason: Adding a pet naming sub-flow screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets biggest funnel friction area, but adding new adoption screens previously dropped conversion by 1.0%.

candidates.title: Move Sign In After Adoption Certificate Step
candidates.change: Moves sign-in screen to take place after adoption certificate creation right before waiting background pet generation.
candidates.why: Moving sign-in was a winning strategy in prior tests. Placing sign-in right after certificate adoption leverages emotional momentum.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to take place after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in was a top winner in prior tests (+5.3%), making this high-confidence.

candidates.title: Desktop Readiness Sound Notification on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Enables sound notifications and completion readiness audio when pet creation finishes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait time is very long (mean 2336s) and 3 emails report pets not showing on desktop because users leave during processing.

guard.reason: Adding readiness notifications and sound options to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait time and desktop drop-off emails, but wait-screen changes showed weak results previously.

candidates.title: Choose Path Carousel Layout with Interactive Cards
candidates.change: Replaces path options with a swipeable carousel layout featuring visual choice cards.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users (76.2% conversion). A interactive carousel simplifies decision-making.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Clarify Account Sync and Pet Protection Headline
candidates.change: Updates headline and body copy on sign-in screen to emphasize automatic pet backup and account synchronization.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect & Sync Your Pet Companion
sign_in.body: Your account securely saves your pet traits, custom accessories, and progress so you can access your companion anywhere.

guard.reason: Updating text copy on the sign-in screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Highest email complaint count and cheap config change, but sign_in copy previously lost -4.3% conversion.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Finalization Tip Banner
candidates.change: Adds a helpful hint banner explaining certificate finalization on the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (60.9%). Providing immediate visual guidance speeds up completion.

adoption_certificate.hint: Tip: Review your pet's adoption details to prepare them for desktop spawn!

guard.reason: Adding a tip banner to the adoption certificate screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost change on highest drop-off step, but hint banners consistently yielded negative results in past tests.

candidates.title: First Day Desktop Toy Bonus Incentive
candidates.change: Displays an unlocked desk ball toy badge on home intro to reward completion.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low (21.9%). Giving an immediate in-app toy bonus encourages completing the final step.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Companion! Free Starter Desk Toy Unlocked

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free Starter Desk Toy Unlocked', violating the rule against mentioning free extras, gifts, or prices.

candidates.title: Redesign Story Screen with Interactive Mascot Welcome
candidates.change: Replaces static story text with a mascot banner and clear introductory messaging.
candidates.why: First step drop-off is 23.8%. Introducing an animated mascot immediately engages users on startup.

intro_story.text: Meet your desktop pet assistant! Choose how your companion lives on your screen.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

lessons_next: Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Adding a new screen at finish (finish, new_screen) was helpful, producing a win in 1 of 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), which won its single test, as well as for all other change categories with 1 test.
Copy changes on sign-in (sign_in, copy) showed no clear positive effect across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all non-winning tests.
Both winning tests (sign_in, reorder and finish, new_screen) were significantly underpredicted.
